# looot-python

> The official Python SDK for looot: `Looot` (sync) and `AsyncLooot` (asyncio).

looot puts 4,200+ tools across 300+ providers behind one key and one prepaid balance. The price shows before every call, and a failed call costs nothing.

## Install

- Python: `pip install looot` (until the first PyPI release: `pip install git+https://github.com/loootai/looot-python`)
- Remote MCP server: `claude mcp add --transport http looot https://api.looot.ai/mcp`

## Use

- `Looot().run_job("people.email.find", {"first_name": "Jane", "last_name": "Doe", "domain": "example.com"}, fallback=True, wait=30)`
- Check `Looot().balance()["available"]` before a paid run.
- Read `status`, `outcome` and `error` on the returned run. A failed run is returned, not raised.
